Uttar Pradesh launches cashless medical scheme for teachers

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is set to launch the Chief Minister Teacher Cashless Medical Scheme on July 8 in Varanasi. The scheme will provide cashless medical treatment facilities and a ₹1 crore insurance cover for teachers and employees. The initiative involves a partnership with the State Bank of India (SBI) for its implementation.
